text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up: Sundance (renewal in ~6w) wants to onboard a custom 7B domain summarizer for legal docs. They asked for Private deployment + HSM and a safety filter to catch PHI/privileged content. They're seeing classification failures in the POC and CS flagged renewal risk. @sam_se can you pick up the eval plan? @miguel_ml please advise on perf/quant options. kelsey_sundance — please add constraints.

kelsey_sundance: Thanks Elaine — correct. Primary goal is extractive case summaries + automatic PHI redaction. Throughput target ~50 req/s, p95 latency target <300ms. Can we do a 2-week pilot? Uploaded a small sample set here: https://s3.redwood/sundance/samples.zip (contains 300 labeled examples).

sam_se: On it. Proposed minimal eval: 1) safety/regression checks against our PHI eval suite; 2) quality: ROUGE + 300 curated ground-truths; 3) perf: latency/throughput bench on a dedicated small pool. Need anonymized samples (PII removed) + expected traffic pattern (burstiness). I'll plan an A/B: base 7B vs quantized 7B-INT4.

miguel_ml: INT4 gives throughput but watch hallucination. Suggest 4-bit outlier-aware quant (AWQ) + KV-cache tuning. For p95 ~300ms you'll likely need a dedicated 1-2 GPU pool with batching tuned (max_concurrent ~8). Example deploy config idea:
```
model: sundance-7b-v1
quant: awq-4
max_concurrent: 8
batching.timeout_ms: 15
```
Also recommend prefix caching for repeated doc headers.

kelsey_sundance: We require HSM for keys (FIPS). Legal also wants audit logs and token-redaction ability. Is Private + customer-managed KMS enough or do we need full on-prem?

ira_product: Private + customer-managed KMS (with keys backed by HSM) should meet most compliance asks. We'll run a security review; Console can enable token-level audit logs and SSO/SCIM. If they insist on air-gapped HSM, we should scope on-prem separately.

elaine_cs: Renewal note: account had 3 missed SLAs last quarter; renewal is at risk if pilot doesn't show traction. Proposed timeline: Week 0 — collect data and legal docs; Week 1 — bench + safety evals; Week 2 — canary pilot + weekly check-ins. Success criteria: PHI false negatives <1%, quality F1 >0.84 on the 300 examples, p95 <350ms at 50 rps. Agree?

kelsey_sundance: :thumbsup: That works. Can we start data transfer today? Also please schedule an enablement session for our eng team next Tue (they're PST).

sam_se: Adding enablement. I'll create a runbook and ask for the sample JSON schema. Created a ticket and tentatively scheduled a kick-off Wed 9am PT. Privacy note: we recommend prefix filtering + an explicit redaction stage before summarization.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-8321 — Sundance 7B private pilot. Assignees: @sam_se, @miguel_ml, @ira_product. ETA: 2w. https://redwood.atlassian/CS-8321

elaine_cs: Thanks all. I'll ping Renewals to flag the account and capture feedback after Week 2. @kelsey_sundance please attach any legal/security docs to CS-8321 and mark items "blocking" if they require legal review.
